title: a16z Podcast: Independents on the Board

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: with Anne Mitchell, Lars Dalgaard, and Scott Kupor "Orthogonal thinking" but "shared core values" -- that's what makes an ideal board...
reader_summary.overview: with Anne Mitchell, Lars Dalgaard, and Scott Kupor "Orthogonal thinking" but "shared core values" -- that's what makes an ideal board... especially when it comes to "independents", i.e., board members who aren't also investors. But how do you get the most out of those independent directors, who are often in the minority?

key_points.text: How do you bring in the best board member for the company, team.
And finally, how can the existing board -- and CEO -- best prepare for the changing dynamics?
Leaders have to evolve with the company after all.
